description: This file defines the ISensorCentral interface, which specifies methods for sensor management including initialization, value retrieval and setting, listener management, and obtaining value sources within the sensor subsystem.

classes.name: ISensorCentral
classes.description: Interface for sensor management, providing methods for initialization, value access, listener registration, and source retrieval.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the sensor central with the given engine state.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the current value of the specified sensor.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a new value for the specified sensor.

methods.name: setAnySensorListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for any sensor event.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for a specific sensor.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Removes a listener from a specific sensor.

methods.name: getValueSource
methods.description: Retrieves the value source associated with a specific sensor.
